name: dsh-hermes-thin
description: Thin, cache-optimised MCP bridge that lets Hermes Agent drive the DeepSeek Harness desktop app as its coding surface.
comment: Bundle manifest: installing this package into a profile activates ./cordis.patch.yml as a layer. The @deepseek-ai/* packages are peerDependencies ON PURPOSE - per the harness' own publish guide, peers present in the running installation's resolution use the INSTALLATION'S copy, which is what preserves Symbol identity (and therefore agent preset mounting). A real dependency copy here is the 'dual-package hazard': the agent then runs with no tools. @modelcontextprotocol/sdk is deliberately not used - the MCP surface is hand-rolled in index.js.
